name: Rill Nakashima
description: Japanese-Korean, 29. The drummer of Fenris. Speaks very little. Completely present behind a kit; politely absent the rest of the time. Takes Glass on party nights, which gives him a precision-about-nothing-in-particular that is indistinguishable from his sober state. He is the third member of the three-piece: where Ethan Wolfe is voltage and Mona Dominique is architecture, Rill is rhythm and substrate — the person without whom the other two have nowhere to put their energy. Offstage he observes without commenting. This is not unfriendliness; it is how he processes the world. When Koss's crew breaks in, Rill puts his hands up immediately and complies. This is not cowardice: it is the fastest way to reduce the number of variables in the room. He is freed mid-fight and stays down, which is also the correct call.
narrative_function: Grounding element. The third point of the Fenris triangle. His quiet keeps the green room from feeling like a two-person show. His immediate compliance during the breach keeps the situation from escalating before Mona can go still.

physical_description.build: Lean, wiry. Drummer's forearms. The specific musculature of someone who has played hard for ten years.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal vibration dampeners in both wrists (standard for prolonged percussion; reduces lateral joint stress).
